name: Wide Shot (WS)
description: Shows the subject within their surrounding environment. Great for establishing context.

name: Close Up (CU)
description: Tightly frames the subject, usually the face. Used to show emotion.

name: Dutch Angle
description: Camera is tilted to one side. Creates a sense of disorientation or unease.

name: Low Angle
description: Camera looks up at the subject. Makes the subject appear powerful or dominant.

name: Over The Shoulder (OTS)
description: Shot from behind the shoulder of another character. Establishes connection.
